scripts.build: bun scripts/prepare.ts && vite build && bun scripts/verify-build.ts
scripts.check: fumadocs-mdx && tsc --noEmit && oxlint --type-aware src scripts e2e vite.config.ts source.config.ts playwright.config.ts && oxfmt --check src scripts e2e content package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts source.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.format: oxfmt --write src scripts e2e content package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts source.config.ts playwright.config.ts
